concepts.title: 浅绿底 · 原版 X
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: KeepXClean browser extension app-icon concept. Reference image: the attached official X social platform logo is the exact shape reference. Preserve its distinctive geometry, proportions, thin rising diagonal and thicker outlined descending diagonal with its internal negative space. Do not replace with a generic letter X, do not round or redraw its strokes. Only change the framing/background or the specified accent. Design a single elegant flat vector-style square app icon, front-facing, on a pure white canvas, centered with generous whitespace. One icon only. No letters or captions, no shadows, no gradients, no texture, no bevels, no 3D. Preserve the official X silhouette exactly. Concept A: a pale mint #EAF6EF rounded-square tile occupying 72% of the canvas, corner radius 22% of tile. Center the unchanged near-black #172B24 official X logo within this tile, logo occupying 57% of tile width with comfortable optical padding. No additional mark or badge. Restrained, calm, precise.
